recovery.scope_limit: Firmware identity and reported settings only; not physical LED output or Cart 2.0 acceptance.

measured_component_snapshot.semantics: Eight cumulative snapshots; the final snapshot covers 754 samples. Values below are from that final snapshot, not an average of snapshots.
limitations: Cycle-counter stage timings may include task preemption; they are not isolated CPU execution time.

The per-poll audio context records bass/mid/treble/volume but omits slowEnergy, which can still activate the pixel breath path; the zero reported bands do not prove the audio modulation fast path was inactive.
The R4 historical measurements were not captured in this same run with identical controls, so they do not prove a causal R4-to-R6 comparison.

matched_tails_off.interpretation: Low reported frame rate and 67.8–78.2 ms whole-frame readings persisted with tail collection off. Tail collection alone therefore does not explain the low rate. Three samples do not establish a full performance distribution or cause.

tail_collection_on.gate: FAILED; frozen FPS floor is 20 and p99 ceiling is 75 ms.

source_binding.palette_path: The measured palette interval wraps the per-pixel legacy hueRotate() call.
source_binding.kernel_residual: The remaining kernel interval after subtracting the compositor is still about 31.2 ms in this cumulative snapshot.

measurement_capability.historical_same_renderer_trace: evidence/cart2-execution-reset-20261010/live-diagnostic/attempt-03/FRAME_CONTEXT_TRACE.json records taskRuntimeStatsAvailable=false and labels CCOUNT intervals as including interruption/preemption; the current renderer uses the same ESP.getCycleCount() source.
official_guidance: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/v4.4.4/esp32/api-reference/kconfig.html (run-time stats are disabled by default; enabling CONFIG_FREERTOS_GENERATE_RUN_TIME_STATS enables task CPU-use accounting; formatted stats also require trace support).

https://github.com/espressif/xtensa-isa-doc (Xtensa ISA reference source; compiled diagnostic binary uses QUOS/QUOU division instructions in hueRotate, but this reference does not establish their latency on the pinned ESP32 configuration).
measurement_capability.implication: Current data measures elapsed cycle counts in code regions, not per-task CPU execution. A source optimization may help, but the captured stage totals cannot separate renderer work from preemption.

decision.compositor_hoist: The measured compositor is about 0.99 ms average; that optimization alone cannot explain or remedy the observed failure.
decision.cause: Not isolated. Audio, palette, and kernel-residual intervals are all large, but cycle-counter timing does not distinguish execution from preemption and the tails-off sample set is small.
decision.next: Continue offline source-level attribution against the exact bound source and saved target map/disassembly. Do not build or install a new candidate until a source correction has a credible, testable link to these measured costs. Preserve all frozen gates.
